rationale.scope: Budgets were fixed from documented guarantees and peer ceilings before any Studio capacity measurement; they are never tuned to an observed result. docs/studio/README.md publishes no latency or rate guarantee ('load/fault campaigns' remain).
rationale.workload: The primary operator paths over real Kestrel HTTP with fixture authentication, antiforgery and the durable PostgreSqlStudioAuditSink: POST /query (read-only RepeatableRead execution with an attempt and a completed audit row), POST /query with explain, GET /schema (PostgreSqlSchemaCapture) and GET /events paging over a seeded PostgreSqlEventStore (two audit rows per page). /operations/replay changes state and is excluded, as the README describes it as an audited quarantine action.
rationale.durationAndRepeats: Two clean exact-candidate runs of 30 minutes each, the minimum every other expansion capacity gate requires.
rationale.offeredRates: 40 queries/s, 2 explains/s, 1 schema read/s and 10 event pages/s. Six query/schema workers stay below the default eight-slot local gate and two event workers below the four-slot event gate, so any 429 indicates leaked admission rather than intended overload.
rationale.minimumAcceptedPerSecond: 95% of each fixed offered rate (Edge maximumSkippedFraction 0.05).
rationale.maximumRejectedFractionAndErrors: Zero: concurrency is below every documented nonqueued gate by construction (README: capacity rejection returns 429 without a durable attempt row).
rationale.query.maximumP99Milliseconds: 1000 ms: a tenth of QueryTimeoutSeconds (default 10 s), equal to the Projections business-commit ceiling; one query performs two durable audit inserts and one read-only transaction.
rationale.explain.maximumP99Milliseconds: 1000 ms: the same audited path; EXPLAIN never enables ANALYZE (README).
rationale.schema.maximumP99Milliseconds: 2000 ms: a fifth of the shared 10 s deadline; the Schema contract bounds the capture itself at 1000 ms and Studio adds snapshot serialization and HTTP.
rationale.event-page.maximumP99Milliseconds: 1000 ms: a tenth of StudioEventOptions.TimeoutSeconds (default 10 s); one bounded Events read (Events read ceiling 500 ms) plus two audit inserts.
rationale.auditRows: Every accepted query, explain and event page writes exactly an attempt and a completed audit row (README 'Audit'); the durable count must equal that expectation.
rationale.maximumOwnedGrowthBytesPerUnit: 1024 bytes per audit row: the fixed-width audit record with its primary-key and time indexes is about 256 bytes; the same 4x amplification factor the Events contract applies. README: no automatic pruning runs in Studio, so growth is linear in audited operations.
rationale.maximumWalBytesPerUnit: 16384 bytes per audit row: the per-durable-row WAL ceiling derived from Jobs (65536 bytes per accepted job over four durable transitions).
rationale.maximumDatabaseBytes: 8 GiB: the Search and Documents whole-database ceiling.
